objective: Add the smallest honest local AEGIS switchboard: authenticated objective intake, governed run preparation, run controls with explicit unsupported-active-build refusals, same-origin status, and SSE projection updates without creating a second authority.
constraints: The dashboard remains a projection and never writes run files, ledger entries, verdicts, permissions, routes, model selections, shell commands, or credentials directly
All run state changes must use exported aegis-run functions and transition(), which records the canonical ledger
Reuse the existing loopback, token, HttpOnly session, security-header, and exact static allow-list controls
Add API routes explicitly; do not widen filesystem serving
POST bodies are JSON only, size bounded, schema bounded, origin checked, and reject shell-command, authority, verdict, token, secret, and arbitrary-path fields
Objective intake may reference only a validated repository task packet and must not accept a shell command
Start means route and prepare the isolated worktree; it must not silently execute a build command
Pause and cancel may operate only when no active synchronous build is running; BUILDING must return 409 CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE
Retry may only transition failed runs into the existing bounded CORRECTING path; actual builder execution remains a separate governed worker step
SSE streams compact projections derived from canonical state; it is notification, not authority
No fake animation, seeded demo state, placeholder success, external network call, commit, push, deployment, publication, or release
stopConditions: The browser would gain a path to execute arbitrary commands or choose a model/provider
The API would mutate runs or the ledger without canonical runtime transitions
Pause or cancel would claim control of a currently blocking synchronous build
A second event store, workflow authority, permission system, or verdict system would be introduced
Authentication or loopback defaults would be weakened
Marc issues STOP or changes scope
